{
  "phoneNote": "The hero text card covers almost all of the pizza dough in the background photo, and the entire address and opening hours block is duplicated verbatim at the bottom.",
  "desktopNote": "The first screen is warm and well-composed, but the bottom of the page duplicates the address and opening hours in two consecutive dark sections, and the team section looks half-empty with just one name.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 3,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 3,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Remove the redundant 'Obiščite nas' and 'Delovni čas' row in the footer, since the exact same information is already displayed in the reservation section immediately above it.",
    "On mobile, stack the hero text card below the image or reduce its height so the pizza dough in the photo is actually visible.",
    "Remove the extra phone and directions bar beneath the mobile header, or fold the single-person 'Kdo skrbi za peč in mize' block into an about paragraph so it doesn't sit in an empty white band."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "On both phone and desktop, the address, directions link, and opening hours are repeated twice in a row in the bottom reservation and footer sections."
  ]
}
